name: Necroverse
source:
Your birthday is coming soon, though you may not get the gift you requested. Quickly running out of reasons, you decide to run away from it all, unaware that a new unfamiliar world exists after death; The Necroverse.

[From [url=https://kale-slice.itch.io/necroverse-beta]itch.io[/url]]
translation: 你的生日就要到了，不过你未必能收到自己想要的礼物。你很快就找不到留下来的理由，于是决定逃离这一切，却不知道死后还存在一个陌生的新世界：死灵界。[引自[url=https://kale-slice.itch.io/necroverse-beta]Itch.io[/url]]
